original_card.question: Can a new local cost interface change the deficit-to-recursive-cost ratio beyond current packing?
methods: Propose a changed helper inventory and derive an optimistic exact moment.
Design a small completed instance and independently verify its endpoint and rank bill.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A new physically realizable contract outside the frozen catalogue whose per-call profile, screened with ceiling.ceiling(), beats the selected word's packing ceiling; a lower cap does not establish identical circuitry or order attainable optima, and is insufficient to pass the stronger-budget target under this model. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

first_step.inspect: Read the selected word's per-call local profile, its packing ceiling and the lever table; run levers.py for the ideal budget of the lever you target.
first_step.scope: Positive control and planning budget only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Before any synthesis, write the candidate per-call local profile (and centre charge / unpaid coordinates if changed) and screen it with ceiling.ceiling(); reject it if even the ideal ceiling does not beat the selected word's by your stated margin.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Packing of the selected word is capped at +0.87% (ceiling model); only a lower local excess spend or a changed coverage law raises the cap.

Continuing a partial cost improvement while leaving the same unpriced consumer, restoration or central-readout obligation unresolved; refresh the family expansion decision first. Local product-retiming evidence has a narrow scope and is not a ban on changed graphs or contracts.

actual_scope: Precision-only follow-up to PR #3133: preserve its exact rank-7 coupled words, T74 owner assignment, width inventory and local paid profile byte for byte; refine the certified complex root from the 24-digit public endpoint to a 40-digit rational lower endpoint; apply explicit positive kappa slacks; compare exactly to PR #3133; and rerun the complete native, replica and outer release. No helper or frame construction changes.
scope_change_reason: The inherited complex-new-helper-inventory card’s construction question has already produced PR #3133’s coupled inventory. This user-directed follow-up asks whether the same literal T74 allocation supports a strictly higher exact public kappa claim by refining only its rational endpoint. That is a changed scope from inventing an inventory to endpoint certification; it matters because the root has a strict margin and the public claim can increase without changing any paid operation. The resulting claim remains a finite conditional candidate, not a selected-frontier update or a structural improvement.
bottleneck_link: It raises the finite public kappa candidate over PR #3133 while leaving the T74 integer-allocation gap of about 1.4053e-9 and all inherited supplier, compiler, physical, caller and analytic obligations unchanged.
stop_rule: Claim the 40-digit endpoint only if both rational moment engines certify the same lower root, the exact comparison to PR #3133 is positive, source-bound native receipt and complete replica admission pass, and the modern outer release passes. Do not infer selected-frontier adoption or an all-size theorem; record the T740 allocation and larger structural routes as open next questions.
evidence: Exact 40-digit root bracket reproduced independently by tools/root.py and tools/audit_allocation_moment.py; T74 owner/cap check; exact gate against the PR #3133 claim; complete source export, native, replica, strict outer-release and authenticated receipt replay; registered package replay and source manifest verification. The precision-30 candidate was not released; its fresh retained bootstrap is used only as the explicitly hash-authenticated reusable source cache.
